title: Recognize a jump
statement:
Find the two-sided limit at $x=0$ for $f(x)=x+[$a]$ on $x<0$ and $f(x)=x-[$a]$ on $x>0$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Read the branch on each side.
The left limit is positive and the right is negative.
solution: The one-sided limits are $[$a]$ and $-[$a]$. They are different, so the two-sided limit does not exist.
